# Get Wrap'd — preview build

Static export of the Get Wrap'd nail wraps site, published to GitHub Pages at
<https://jacklot1122.github.io/get-wrapd-preview/>.

**Do not edit this repo by hand.** Everything here is generated output and is
overwritten on every publish. The site source lives in the private
`get-wrapd` repo; refresh this preview from there with:

```
npm run build:pages
npm run deploy:pages
```
